rca of the issue: test_iter82 failures RCA: engine.tg was refactored from a module-level async function to an instance method on TradingEngine (engine.py line 47). The legacy helper run() in test_iter80_ema_test.py does monkeypatch.setattr(engine_mod, 'tg', _noop) without raising=False, so pytest aborts with AttributeError before the real test body runs. Mitigation applied: raising=False on both engine_mod.tg and engine_mod.evaluate_signal patches (both are now obsolete module attributes). Permanent fix (main agent): delete test_iter80_ema_test.py and move its run() helper into conftest.py referencing TradingEngine instance methods only.
